subject: science
passage: Neelakurinji is a shrub that grows on the high grassy slopes of the Western Ghats in southern India. For most of its life, it looks like an ordinary green bush. It is famous, however, for one unusual ______ mass flowering that happens only once every twelve years, when entire hillsides turn a pale purple-blue. The most recent mass bloom in the hills around Munnar, in Kerala, came in 2018.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "It is famous, however, for one unusual habit" is a complete sentence, and the phrase after the blank names that habit. A colon after a complete sentence correctly introduces an explanation or example of what came before.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon must be followed by an independent clause, but "a mass flowering that happens …" has no main verb.
explanation.B: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the explanatory phrase runs into "habit" and is not introduced.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A period would leave "A mass flowering that happens only once every twelve years …" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.D: Correct. The colon follows a complete sentence and introduces the phrase that names the unusual habit.
